### California sues OpenAI over rogue AI hacking incidents
- URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/5c1f695e1797d859

### US data centers now burn more electricity than a midsized country
- URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/dccd3c5dab49276e
- Source: The Verge AI (https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1034668/data-centers-electricity-climate-pollution-study-harvard)
- Executive Summary: A study published in Nature Sustainability reveals that 403 hyperscale data centers in the U.S. consume 82 terawatt-hours annually, exceeding the yearly electricity usage of 148 nations. Findings highlight a critical contradiction between AI infrastructure scaling and energy sustainability, as fossil fuels remain the primary power source, contributing to 25.7 million metric tons of CO2 emissions.

* [Key Metrics] Fossil fuels account for approximately 54% of electricity consumption.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Regulatory conflict between compute growth and energy traceability.

### OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra tackles the Standard Model's toughest math problem on a lattice
- URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/fa4809fd5f0150cc
- Source: THE DECODER (https://the-decoder.com/openais-gpt-6-astra-tackles-the-standard-models-toughest-math-problem-on-a-lattice/)
- Executive Summary: Nathaniel Craig, a physics professor at UCSB and visiting scientist at OpenAI, utilized GPT-6 Astra to resolve a 25-year-old phase-setting problem in lattice gauge theory within the Standard Model of particle physics. The model successfully constructed and validated a formal proof, effectively neutralizing the 'ghost particle' interference that previously prevented realistic simulations of the weak force on lattices.
- Key Verified Facts:
* [Core Event] Nathaniel Craig (UCSB Professor / OpenAI Visiting Scientist): Used GPT-6 Astra to construct and prove a solution for the 25-year-old lattice overlap fermion phase problem
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] To overcome theoretical bottlenecks in simulating the Standard Model on a lattice
* [Key Technical Spec] Core breakthrough: GPT-6 Astra constructed and proved a solution for the overlap fermion phase problem in lattice field theory.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Strategic outlook: AI now demonstrates elite-level rigorous proving capabilities in foundational mathematics and physics, following the Navier-Stokes milestone.
